scripts.build:frontend: mise exec node@${FRONTEND_NODE_VERSION:-${NODE_VERSION}} -- npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.build:backend: mise exec node@${BACKEND_NODE_VERSION:-${NODE_VERSION}} -- npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start:frontend: mise exec node@${FRONTEND_NODE_VERSION:-${NODE_VERSION}} -- npm run start --prefix frontend
scripts.start:backend: mise exec node@${BACKEND_NODE_VERSION:-${NODE_VERSION}} -- npm run start --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm run test:stack && npm run test:root
